senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; חָכַךְ I; cmp. חָח)hook, fish-hook.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:1:11">Y. Pes. IV, 30ᵈ</cite> top.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:4">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>בנחל … נפלה ח׳ וכ׳</he> if the fish-hook is thrown into the rapid river (to catch the fish), what can the waters in the pond do (if the great die, what can common humanity expect)?—
<cite ref="Eruvin 19a:2">Erub. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>מטילין לו ח׳ וכ׳</he> they put a hook into the convict’s mouth &c.; a. e.—Pl. <he>חַכִּין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 8:17">Tosef. B. Kam. VIII, 17</cite>. Sifré Num. s. 44 <he>גררום בחַכֵּי ברזל</he> they dragged them out of the sanctuary with iron hooks (on shafts, v. <cite ref="B01127"><he>בַּקְלוֹסָא</he></cite>); Yalk. ib. 712 <he>בקני</he> (corr. acc.); Sifra Sh’mini, introd. <he>חנית של ברזל</he> (read: <cite ref="H00940"><he>חַכִּים</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 11:13">Tosef. B. Kam. XI, 13</cite> <he>שלש חכין</he> (Var. <cite ref="H00293"><he>חוטין</he></cite>, <he>כופין</he>) three fuller’s hooks (for stretching clothes; v. <cite ref="H00234"><he>חוֹב</he> II</cite>, 2).
